fields.name: Mahi Monocrystalline Half-Cell 550W Panel
fields.description: Engineered with half-cut cell technology, this premium 550W module delivers peak solar output even in cloudy conditions or partial shade. Features an anodized aluminum alloy frame and anti-reflective tempered glass.
fields.short_description: Premium 550W half-cell solar panel with 22.8% efficiency rating.

fields.name: Mahi Smart Hybrid Inverter 5KW
fields.description: Next-generation 5KW hybrid inverter facilitating grid-tie telemetry, battery storage management, and automatic micro-grid transition within 10 milliseconds during load shedding. Includes built-in Wi-Fi monitoring.
fields.short_description: 5KW intelligent hybrid inverter with real-time app diagnostics.

fields.name: Mahi PowerWall LiFePO4 Battery 10KWh
fields.description: Ultra-reliable Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) solar storage battery boasting a capacity of 10KWh and up to 6000 cycles at 80% Depth of Discharge. Features dynamic battery management system (BMS) controls.
fields.short_description: 10KWh high-capacity LiFePO4 battery wall for solar storage storage.
